answer_1.quote: For each paradigm to be added to the lexicon, e.g., FLY, we aim to select as few sources as possible to be manually realized, e.g., {(FLY, NFIN, fly), (FLY, PST, flew)} such that the forms realizing the remaining cells can be predicted, i.e., flies, flying, flown.
